visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with light brown hair styled in small pigtails, wearing a white lace top and a gold necklace, stands in a brightly lit indoor studio. She holds a pink handheld skincare device (Medicube AGE-R Booster Pro) and points to it. Behind her, a collage of Korean celebrities and the Olive Young storefront appears as a multi-layered overlay. Text labels appear at the bottom. (2) The scene shifts to a close-up of the device's circular head. The woman applies a clear serum to her right cheek and then uses the device, which emits a bright orange circular light. On-screen text indicates 'Booster mode'. She demonstrates circular motions on her skin, which appears dewy and reflective under the studio lighting. (3) Transitioning to another mode, the device's light turns blue. She wears a fuzzy brown headband and uses the device near her nose and cheeks. Text labels mention 'Air Shot mode' and pore tightening effects. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting her smooth skin texture. (4) The woman demonstrates the third mode with a red light, 'DERMA-S mode'. She moves the device along her jawline and forehead. A small inset graphic shows a cross-section of skin layers being stimulated. She smiles confidently at the camera, her makeup looking natural and luminous. (5) In the final phase, she shows a smartphone screen with an app interface that controls the device via Bluetooth. She finishes by applying makeup with a brush, looking satisfied with the smooth application. She holds the device up one last time, recommending it with a cheerful expression in the studio setting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, energetic female voice narrates in Mandarin, introducing the product with high enthusiasm. The BGM is an upbeat electronic pop track with a synth-bass rhythm. Short digital 'click' sound effects punctuate the introduction of celebrities. (2) As the serum is shown, a subtle liquid 'drop' SFX is audible. The narrator describes the 'Booster mode' with an informative and friendly tone. The BGM remains consistent in tempo and volume. A gentle digital chime occurs as the device is turned on. (3) Transitioning to the 'Air Shot' demonstration, a quick 'whoosh' SFX signals the scene change. The narrator's speech rate is fast but clear, emphasizing the effectiveness of the treatment. Background synth pads provide a textured layer to the mix. (4) The audio features 'ding' sound effects to highlight key benefits and 'Fact Check' labels. The vocal arousal remains high, conveying positivity. No significant background noise is detected, maintaining a professional studio sound quality. (5) In the final phase, the BGM swells slightly as the narrator concludes her recommendation. A bright 'sparkle' SFX accompanies the final shot of her glowing skin. The track ends with a clean fade-out precisely at the final frame.
